name: EXAMPLE - Anadolu Hygiene Industries
comment: Diaper supplier. Sea freight Mersin to Mogadishu approx 30 days door to door - put this on the reordering rule lead time.

name: EXAMPLE - Fujian Hygiene Products Co Ltd
comment: Alternative diaper supplier. Sea freight approx 45 days. Longer lead time but lower FOB - compare on LANDED cost once the first container is costed, not on FOB.

name: EXAMPLE - Gulf Hygiene Trading FZE
comment: Regional stockist. Short lead time and small lot sizes - the one to use for a gap-fill rather than a planned container.

name: EXAMPLE - Port Clearing Agents Ltd
comment: Customs clearing and forwarding. Bills against the landed cost services SRV-LC-*. Their invoice must reach the accountant BEFORE the goods are sold - see the README on landed cost timing.

name: EXAMPLE - Inland Haulage Services
comment: Port to warehouse trucking. Bills against SRV-LC-006 Inland Transport.

name: EXAMPLE - Bakara Wholesale Distributor
comment: Domestic wholesale. Assign the Wholesale pricelist and a credit limit.

name: EXAMPLE - Retail Supermarket Chain
comment: Domestic retail chain. Assign the Retail pricelist.

name: EXAMPLE - City Pharmacy Group
comment: Pharmacy chain - diapers and sanitary lines. Retail pricelist.

name: EXAMPLE - Nairobi Import Partners
comment: EXPORT customer - assign the Export pricelist AND the Export Zero Rated fiscal position. The pricelist sets the price, the fiscal position sets the tax; neither does the other job.

name: EXAMPLE - Addis Trading PLC
comment: EXPORT customer - Export pricelist and Export Zero Rated fiscal position.

name: EXAMPLE - Jiangsu Tissue Mill Co Ltd
comment: PHASE 2 - tissue pack supplier for the factory. Not needed until manufacturing starts.

name: EXAMPLE - Local Carton and Print
comment: PHASE 2 - carton boxes and labels for the factory. Short lead time.
